title: Greek Whole Milk Yogurt, Non‑Fruit Flavors

content.title: About
content.content: Greek whole‑milk yogurt is a thick, creamy dairy product made by double‑straining regular yogurt. It is flavored with non‑fruit ingredients such as vanilla, honey, caramel, or spices.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: Greek yogurt contains two to three times more protein than regular yogurt.
The traditional straining process removes most of the whey, giving the product its dense texture.
Non‑fruit flavors often use natural aromatics and spices, making them suitable for people with fruit allergies.
Greek yogurt is frequently used in cooking as a substitute for sour cream or mayonnaise.
In many countries Greek yogurt is considered a premium product and commands a higher price.

items.title: High in protein
items.content: A 200 g serving provides about 20 g of protein, supporting muscle growth and repair.

items.title: Source of probiotics
items.content: Live cultures like Lactobacillus and Bifidobacterium promote gut health.

items.title: Calcium and vitamin D
items.content: Help maintain strong bones and teeth.

items.title: Low added sugar
items.content: Non‑fruit varieties usually contain less added sugar, beneficial for blood‑glucose control.

items.title: Beneficial fats
items.content: Whole‑milk retains some milk fats, including conjugated linoleic acid (CLA) with antioxidant properties.

items.title: Lactose intolerance
items.content: People who are lactose intolerant may experience discomfort.

items.title: Milk‑protein allergy
items.content: Casein and whey proteins can trigger allergic reactions.

items.title: High calorie density
items.content: Whole‑milk Greek yogurt is more caloric than low‑fat versions.

items.title: Sodium content
items.content: Some flavored varieties may contain added salt.

content.title: How to Eat
content.content: Enjoy it plain, blend into smoothies, use in sauces, dips, baked goods, or as a base for desserts. Non‑fruit flavors pair well with nuts, honey, granola, and spices.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Keep refrigerated at 1‑4 °C in the original container. Once opened, consume within 5‑7 days. Do not freeze, as texture may change.
